messages.body:
On Tue, Jan 21, 2025, Wong, Sergio E. via AMBER wrote:
>
>     I’m trying to install amber24 on AMD MI50 chips.  I’m compiling
>     the serial version.  Unfortunately when I run the tests, I get the
>     following type of error:
>
>Error: unspecified launch failure launching kernel kgBuildSpecial2RestNBPreList
>
>     The non gti bits do not show this type of error.  Does anyone know how
>     to address this issue?
I'm cc-ing this to Paul.Bauer.amd.
com, but others on the list may recognize
the issue.  Amber should(!) build and run on MI50 boards.  I'm guessing that
one may need more information about the compiler and OS versions you are
using.  It sounds like you are running the pmemd tests, but a specific
pointer to a test that works, and to one that fails, would also be helpful.
(I'm just a conduit here--I don't have access to any such machine.)
...dac
